title: mokumesh mapping configuration
description: The calibration mokumesh saves and loads (ADR-0001 decision 7). Outputs are displays the Mac drives; each holds one or more regions, one per projector, so a splitter that divides one output among several projectors is a display with several regions (decision 6). Coordinates are normalized to 0–1.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this format. Raised when the shape changes incompatibly.

channel.description: The link channel the receiver checks in under (org.mokume-metal.mokumesh.<channel>).

display.description: How to find the display. The id (CGDirectDisplayID) is tried first and the name second, because ids can change when displays are reconnected.

stream.description: The name of the stream this region shows.

corners.description: Where the picture's top-left, top-right, bottom-right and bottom-left corners land, normalized within the region. They must form a convex quadrilateral in that order.

rect.description: A rectangle normalized to the display's width and height.
